transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um… I guess I’m here because the clinic doctor was kind of on me about my eating. I don’t know. Most days I just keep it simple—coffee in the morning, maybe a few bites of something between jobs, and a small dinner if I’m not too busy with class paperwork.
Do you ever feel anxious about gaining weight or have concerns about how your body looks?

Yeah… sometimes. Mostly if I eat something, like, heavy. Pizza, or a big sandwich. I start feeling kind of panicky, like I’m going to wake up bigger and… slower, I guess. Like I won’t be able to move around at work the way I need to, up ladders and in tight rooms.
After you eat something that makes you feel anxious, do you ever try to 'undo' it by doing things like making yourself sick, exercising a lot more than usual, or using laxatives?
I… I don’t really know. I mean, I’ll feel bad about it, but I’m not sure I’d call it “undoing” it. I don’t really like talking about that stuff.

I understand it's difficult to talk about, but when you feel anxious after eating something heavy, do you ever make yourself vomit, exercise much more than usual, or use laxatives to try to manage those feelings?
I don’t know… not really something I want to get into. I just get uncomfortable after, and then I try to get through the rest of the day.
When you feel uncomfortable after eating something heavy, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or push yourself to exercise more than you normally would?
I’m… not sure. I don’t really think of it that way. I mostly just feel uncomfortable and kind of try to move on with the day.
When you feel panicky or uncomfortable after eating something heavy, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise much more than usual to try to manage those feelings?
I… I don’t think so. I mean, I get really uncomfortable, but I usually just try to sit with it or distract myself. I don’t really have a clear answer beyond that.
When you feel panicky or uncomfortable after eating something heavy, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or push yourself to exercise more than you normally would?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say that, really. I just get really uneasy and try to wait it out. I don’t think I do those things.
When you feel panicky or uncomfortable after eating something heavy, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise much more than usual to manage those feelings?
I really don’t think I do that. I mean… I feel awful sometimes, but I don’t make myself throw up or anything like that. I mostly just get quiet and wait for it to pass.

Can you think of a time when you felt especially panicky after eating something heavy—like pizza or a big sandwich—where you did something to try to control your weight, like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or pushing yourself to exercise a lot more than usual?

I can’t really think of a specific time like that. I mean, I’ve felt panicky after eating heavier stuff, but… I don’t remember doing something like that to fix it. I usually just sort of try to get through it.
Have you ever made yourself vomit, used laxatives, or exercised far more than usual after eating something heavy, even if it was just once or twice?
No… I don’t think so. I can’t remember doing that, even once. I just get really anxious and kind of sit with it until it goes down.
Have you ever done anything like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual specifically after eating to control your weight or how your body feels?
I don’t think so. Not like… on purpose after eating to change anything. I just feel bad and try to wait it out.
Have you ever made yourself vomit, used laxatives, or exercised far more than usual specifically after eating to control your weight or how your body feels?
No… not that I can remember. I know I’ve felt uncomfortable after eating, but I haven’t done those things to try to change it.

Have you ever, even once or twice, done something like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual specifically to try to control your weight or how your body feels after eating?
No. I mean… I don’t think I’ve ever done that, not specifically to control things after eating.
Have you ever, even once or twice, made yourself vomit, used laxatives, or exercised far more than usual specifically after eating to try to control your weight or how your body feels?
I… no. I don’t have an example of doing that, even once or twice.

Have you ever, even once or twice, done something like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual specifically after eating to try to control your weight or how your body feels?
I’ve already said… no, I don’t think so. I can’t think of a time I did something like that after eating.
Have there been times when you felt like you lost control over your eating and ate a large amount of food in a short period of time, even if you weren’t hungry?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve eaten more than I planned sometimes, but not like I lost control or anything.
Have there been times when you ate a much larger amount of food than most people would in a short period of time, even if you weren't really hungry?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I might eat more than I meant to sometimes, but not a huge amount like that.
Have there been times when you’ve eaten a lot more than you meant to, even when you weren’t really hungry, without making up for it in any way afterward?
Not really… I mean, I’ve eaten more than I meant to sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it was a lot, and I don’t think about “making up for it” after.

Have there been times when you’ve eaten a much larger amount of food than you intended in a short period of time, even when you weren’t really hungry, without doing anything to make up for it afterward?
I don’t think so… not in that way. I might eat more than I meant to once in a while, but not a much larger amount, and I don’t really do anything after.
